subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `StripPlainTextToolCallOptions.preserveCodeRegions` as a new public plugin SDK contract for `stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks`, or keep code-aware stripping internal only?
rationale: The bug fix itself belongs in shared repair/sanitization code, but the exported SDK option grows a public third-party contract under the plugin SDK boundary and cannot be accepted purely by automation.

options.title: Accept the SDK opt-in
options.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers are comfortable with a strict-default helper plus an explicit public code-region preservation option.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Remove the exported options type and public parameter, while preserving internal delivery callers' code-region predicates.

options.title: Pause for SDK design
options.body: Hold the PR until a maintainer chooses a different public helper shape or documents the plugin-facing contract more explicitly.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK opt-in
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers are comfortable with a strict-default helper plus an explicit public code-region preservation option.
